mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `voucher` ( merchant_id, title, sub_title, image_url, stock, sold_count, amount, pay_value, status, begin_time, end_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{imageUrl}, #{stock}, 0, #{amount}, #{payValue}, #{status}, #{beginTime}, #{endTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `voucher` WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM `voucher` WHERE status = 1 AND stock > 0 AND (begin_time IS NULL OR begin_time <= NOW()) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM `voucher` ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `voucher` SET title = #{title}, sub_title = #{subTitle}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, stock = #{stock}, amount = #{amount}, pay_value = #{payValue}, status = #{status}, begin_time = #{beginTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `voucher` SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 1 AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time <= NOW() LIMIT #{limit}
UPDATE `voucher` SET stock = #{stock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `voucher` SET stock = GREATEST(stock - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `voucher` SET stock = stock - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(mt.name, '其他') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `voucher` v LEFT JOIN `merchant` m ON v.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN `merchant_type` mt ON m.type_id = mt.id GROUP BY COALESCE(mt.name, '其他') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, WEEKDAY(create_time) AS weekIndex, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `voucher` WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m'), WEEKDAY(create_time)
